name: This LOVE
source:
This is a heartwarming adventure game set in the school.
The protagonist and 3 girls flourish while they prepare for the school festival.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE053246.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款以校园为舞台的温馨冒险游戏。主人公与三名少女在筹备校园祭的过程中共同成长，绽放属于自己的青春光彩。

[内容取自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE053246.html]DLsite English[/url]]
